<!-- Thanks! A few lines per section is plenty. Writing the problem yourself?
See https://github.com/gvart/proschi/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-a-new-problem -->

## The system

What should be designed, in a sentence or two (e.g. "a ride-hailing dispatch
service that matches riders with nearby drivers").

## The key idea

What should the solver learn? Which shortcut should fail (no cache, one
database for everything, synchronous calls that should be a queue)?

## Use cases and scale

The main use cases and rough numbers, if you have them (users, requests per
second, data sizes, latency or availability targets).

## Difficulty and sources

Easy, medium or hard, and any public write-up it is based on (an engineering
blog post, a paper, a talk).
